_about: Translation preset per video, handed to the console in the beacon (sourceLanguage, detectableLanguages, translationModel).
Keys are video names (file name without extension, matched like description.txt). A video without a preset gets none: the console uses its own .env task.
source: the language the video is spoken in, one fixed code per video (no auto: detection mixes languages up).
model: delta2 for a source Delta2 serves (en de es fr it nl pt ru), auto for the rest (ja).
Sources: the main language of each video (the 2026-10-06 / 2026-10-12 transcripts; Stella_Kink checked by ear: German).
